heading: INT. OCEAN-FLOOR RESEARCH HABITAT - GALLEY - NIGHT

units.text: INT. OCEAN-FLOOR RESEARCH HABITAT - GALLEY - NIGHT
A cylinder of brushed steel and humming pipes.
A porthole shows only blackness and the occasional drifting flake of snow.
Three tin cups steam on a narrow table.
DR. SERAPHINA OYELARAN-VOSS (50s, marine biologist, silver braid, a mug warming her palms) sits motionless, eyes on the dark glass.
Across from her, ENGINEER ILKA MARCHETTI (40s, grease under her nails, a stubborn jaw) stirs her coffee without drinking it.
At the end of the table, DR. KOFI LUNDGREN (30s, hydrologist) taps a stylus against a dead tablet.
The hull groans.
A distant, long, patient sound, like a whale in a tunnel.
No one flinches.
They have heard it for weeks.
Fourteen days of nothing.
units.name: SERAPHINA

units.text: Fourteen days of the same nothing.
units.name: KOFI

units.text: The pumps are fine. The scrubbers are fine. The only thing that isn't fine is the schedule.
units.name: ILKA

units.text: She wants us topside by Thursday.
units.name: SERAPHINA

units.text: She wants a lot of things.
units.name: ILKA

units.text: Who is "she"?
units.name: KOFI

units.text: Command. Surface. The woman with the clipboard.
units.name: ILKA

units.text: She means well.
units.name: SERAPHINA

units.text: She means to bring us up before we have finished, and she knows it.
units.name: ILKA

units.text: Kofi sets down his stylus.
Looks at the porthole, then at the two women, then at the cups.
Did she say why Thursday?
units.name: KOFI

units.text: The storm window closes.
units.name: SERAPHINA

units.text: Storm window. Funding window. Pick one.
units.name: ILKA

units.text: The hull groans again, lower.
Seraphina rests her hand on the table and feels it hum through the steel.
Then we use the days we have.
units.name: SERAPHINA

units.text: She will not like that.
units.name: ILKA

units.text: She does not have to be here.
units.name: SERAPHINA

units.text: Ilka almost smiles.
At last she drinks.
